assumptions.wrapper_binding: Matched all45 convolution shape/attribute records in the two cached input-history wrappers to source topology. This is static code evidence, not a fresh execution trace.

findings: All19 pointwise convolutions admit contiguous weight-left torch.mm(W[:,:,0],x[0]) with one bias add; no temporal im2col or activation transpose is mathematically required.
Channels-last F.linear(x.transpose(1,2),W[:,:,0],bias) is also equivalent but the transpose is a view and following BCT convolutions may materialize its output. Include this conversion in any timing.

The6 transpose convolutions can be expressed as phase GEMMs using constant W split by stride. Prepack constant [Cout*stride,Cin] phase matrices once; current and previous contributions plus bias are assembled in chronological order. Original-input history semantics can be kept. This may trade convolution setup for GEMM/layout costs.

The final32-to1 K7 convolution admits seven shifted32-channel GEMMs or an unfold224-by-T matrix multiply, but the latter materializes windows and the small total arithmetic makes it a lower-priority target.
Depthwise K7 has only7 multiplies per emitted channel-time sample. A dense GEMM would introduce zeros or explicit gathers; it is not the same favorable mapping as pointwise.

Generated wrappers dispatch45 external convolutions with bias=None and generated Metal pointwise/state kernels. Bias/Snake/residual fusion already occurs, so source-level separate-add counts are not launch counts.

The original-history generated first transpose state is a strided slice; experiment.CompiledModel.decode materializes required contiguous returned histories outside the compiled call. This is an additional8,192-byte first-stage copy after the40ms compiled wrapper. The80ms wrapper returns all states contiguous, so no such extra copy is required there.

No activation transpose or matrix-multiply wrapper is present in these cached call bodies. reinterpret_tensor is metadata-only aliasing, while empty_strided is allocation and generated copy kernels perform actual copies. Backend-internal convolution layouts are not established here.

A phase-GEMM implementation can retain original input-history semantics while projecting current inputs through the first stride of W and [history,x[:-1]] through the second stride. Each GEMM has outputrows Cout*stride and T columns; their chronological sum gets bias once. This omits the two discarded edge phases without carrying projected-output state. Logical saved MACs are41,328,640 per packet across all6stages, not a runtime estimate.
